hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.status: HS-Stroke discovery cohort. The TS+LR (R4/C7/R9-C2) and EEGNet (R8-B/R9-C) outcomes on these arms are KNOWN (G0: EEGNet ranks first in every arm; D_EEGNet,TSLR(L|P) = +7.14). ShallowConvNet has never been run on HS-Stroke; the training-seed replicates (SH2, EG2) have never been run. Prior knowledge used in choosing the roster: on Lee2019 (R7-C6, R8-D/E, trial level) ShallowConvNet's exact-copy effect exceeded EEGNet's, which exceeded TS+LR's.
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.directional_expectation_declared: from the Lee2019 trial-level ordering: D_Shallow,TSLR(L|P) > 0 and D_Shallow,EEGNet(L|P) > 0. No expectation is declared for ShallowConvNet's CLEAN or PLACEBO rank. All tests are two-sided.
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.H1: model-gap distortion D_AB = G_AB(L) - G_AB(P) for (EEGNet,TSLR), (Shallow,TSLR), (Shallow,EEGNet); participant level (14); exact two-sided sign-flip; Holm over the 3 pairs (the EEGNet,TSLR member is known from G0 and included for completeness)
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.H2: ranking reversal between PLACEBO and LEAKED (primary) and CLEAN and LEAKED (secondary; Holm over the 3 D(L|C)): classified per pair as NO_REVERSAL / DESCRIPTIVE_REVERSAL / SUPPORTED_CROSSING / SUPPORTED_REVERSAL (pmis_r10.ranking.reversal_class); top-1 change supported only if the pair is SUPPORTED_REVERSAL; participant-cluster bootstrap (20,000) of P(first) and P(order differs); participant-level order changes descriptive
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.H3: within-benchmark model-selection counterfactual: winner on LEAKED vs winner on PLACEBO (primary) and CLEAN; regret on the matched arm; relevant if regret >= 2 BA points (SESOI); bootstrap P(winner differs) and regret interval
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.H4: attribution on exposed scored trials with R9-C's split halves: dE_AB (exposure with half support fixed) and dS_AB (half same-run support, no own copy) for the 3 pairs, Holm over 6; path shares and the step at which any exposed-trial order change occurs are descriptive; stitched OWN / OTHER arms are trial-conditional counterfactuals, never deployable models; identified at half exposure density only
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.SESOI: 2 BA points (the vendored R4 / Paper A Section 2.3 value, fixed before R10-A) for D, gaps and regret labels; it does not change any test
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.robustness: training seed: H1-H3 repeated on replicate R2 (SH2 + EG2 + deterministic TS+LR); declared criteria in pmis_r10.analysis.robustness. Participants: n positive, leave-one-participant-out top-1 and sign of D. Fold seeds: per-seed orders and D
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.reporting_rule: every outcome is reported whatever its sign or size; a null is a result; no model, arm, seed, split or threshold is added or changed after any outcome

design.arms: R4 frozen G2 manifest L, P, C and R9-C's split-half arms L1, L2 (same halves: R9-C split commitment re-verified)

models.TSLR: frozen R4 TSLRw, existing outputs (C7: L, P, C; R9-C2: L1, L2); deterministic
models.EEGNet: EEGNet-8,2 (R4/R8-B), final epoch of 100; R1 = existing outputs (R8-B: L, P, C; R9-C: L1, L2); R2 = new replicate EG2
models.Shallow: ShallowConvNet (R7-C6 GroupShallow, Schirrmeister 2017 at 128 Hz: 40 x 13 temporal, 40 x C spatial, BN, square, avg-pool 37/7, log, dropout 0.5, dense), Adam 1e-3, batch 64, 100 epochs, final epoch, same input as EEGNet (4-40 Hz, 128 Hz, 11 channels, per-trial channel z-score); R1 = SH1, R2 = SH2

design.CRN: per fold: group (L, L1, L2, P, L') and group (C, C'), one pair seed and one group seed; L' and C' are A/A duplicates in every fold and must be bit-identical (stop rule)
design.read_out: final epoch only (R4's arms leave no validation set; no early-stopping read-out is computed)
design.excluded: TCFormer (projected about 30 GPU-h for 5 arms x 210 folds sequentially, against about 1 h for ShallowConvNet; decided from the synthetic pilot before any HS-Stroke outcome); validation-selected read-outs
design.unit: participant (14); BA pooled over each participant's scored trials per fold seed, mean over seeds 42-44

analysis.primary_requires: SH1 complete; R2 analysed only if SH2 and EG2 are both complete
